name: noos
description: Displaces the OS surface the runtime's Unix PAL reaches for

objects.note: The OS surface the runtime's Unix PAL reaches for. PalUnix.cpp.o is linked whole because RhFailFast pulls it, and libSystem.Native's pal_io comes with it, so 150 libc entry points go live and drag 96 musl members in: crash dumps, dlopen, CPU counting, directory walking. None can be serviced here. Same rule as nothread: this works by definition, so it must precede libc.a.
